plan.notes: Source: official Barton CC degree map 'Chemistry, Emphasis of Study, Associate in Science - 60 Credit Hours' (Review Date: 09/25, Effective Date: 08/25; no catalog-year label, stamped retrieval year 2026-2027). Sequenced TERM 1-4 as printed; term totals 15/14/16/15 = 60 reconcile exactly. The map recommends a PHED activity or performance course and BRTN 1103 for the Barton Designated Requirement, and a performance course in the arts. To meet the Social & Behavioral Sciences criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ANTH, ECON, GEOG, POLS, PSYC, SOCI). To meet the Arts & Humanities criteria there must be at least two courses from two different subject areas (ARTS, COMM, DANC, ENGL, HIST, LITR, LANG, MUSI, PHIL, RELI, THEA).
